devdoc.details: The owner is `GovernanceRoot`. Scheduling and cancellation are     role-gated (owner, registered proposers/cancellers, and the action's     proposer for cancellation); execution is permissionless inside the     open-to-execute window. Executor configuration changes require an exact,     isolated governed self-call with a direction-sensitive action class.

GovernanceActionPolicyValidated(uint16,b.details: `phase` is `1` for scheduling and `2` for execution.

TerminalFreezeActionMembershipUpdated(ui.details: `mutationCause` is 1 for append, 2 for elapsed compaction, and 3 for      action-terminal cleanup. `rawIndex` is zero-based and `remainingCount`      is the post-mutation raw membership count for `scopeHash`.

commitGenesisPlan(bytes32).details: The commitment includes this chain and Executor. Keeping it out of      constructor bytecode avoids a self-reference through target codehashes.

extendGovernanceActionPolicy(uint64,byte.details: Entries sort by keccak256(abi.encode(actionClass,target,selector)).      Requires a sealed Executor and an ordinary root-proposed class-3      batch consisting exactly of this call then manifest publication.

initializeGenesis((address,address,bytes.details: Only these committed genesis batches execute immediately. They retain      ordinary action classes, calldata publication, per-call transition      contexts, action policy, replay protection and final inventory checks.      Product initialization never partially persists: the final batch      must seal. An optional prior preparation remains available on retry.

liveTerminalFreezeActionAt(bytes32,uint2.details: Indices densely enumerate only pre-deadline actions in the backing      set's deterministic order; elapsed entries are skipped without a      state mutation.

liveTerminalFreezeActionCount(bytes32).details: Actions remain in the O(1) mutation index until a terminal state      transition, but this view excludes them as soon as their veto deadline      is reached.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

prepareGenesis((address,address,bytes32,.details: Uses the identical complete plan encoding. Preparation is durable;      failed initialization leaves it available for an exact-plan retry.      No ordinary pre-seal actions may run after the plan is committed.

publishGovernanceCallData(bytes[]).details: Permissionless and content-addressed: the key is     `keccak256(abi.encodePacked(keccak256(callDatas[0]), ...))`, so a     published blob can never disagree with the `callDataHash` entries of     a batch that resolves to it. Republishing an existing set is     idempotent. Scheduling requires the batch's preimages to be     published so the stored action record carries the pointer for the     full open-to-execute window.

registerFreezeSelector(address,bytes4,bo.details: An exact isolated self-call is required. Registering this protective      backstop is IMMEDIATE_TIGHTENING; clearing it requires      DELAYED_LOOSENING. Target-side class enforcement remains primary.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

scheduleGovernanceBatch(uint8,(address,u.details: Reverts with `CallDataNotPublished` unless the exact calldata     preimages for `calls` were published via `publishGovernanceCallData`     (same transaction is fine); the stored action record then carries     the SSTORE2 pointer ([GOV-BATCH] rule 5).

setTighteningCall(address,bytes4,bool).details: An exact isolated self-call is required. Enabling the fast path      requires DELAYED_LOOSENING; disabling it is IMMEDIATE_TIGHTENING.      The classifier is advisory; target-side class enforcement remains primary.

terminalFreezeActionPage(bytes32,uint256.details: Entries may be elapsed until permissionless pruning runs; compare      each deadline with the current block timestamp.

terminalFreezeLiveActionUsage(bytes32,ad.details: Usage includes elapsed memberships until bounded pruning runs.

terminalFreezeVetoGuardian(bytes32).details: Terminal-freeze batches are indexed once under every distinct     `GovernanceCall.scopeHash`, never under the V2 action aggregate.     Per-scope and global holders are additive veto authorities. The     address is nonzero only when their deduplicated union has exactly one     member; otherwise `guardian` is the zero-address sentinel. Use     `terminalFreezeVetoGuardianSet` plus RoleRegistry enumeration for the     complete set. `vetoDeadline` is zero when the scope has no     live (scheduled, pre-`notBefore`) terminal-freeze action. Because a     scope may have several live actions, use     `liveTerminalFreezeActionCount`/`liveTerminalFreezeActionAt` to     enumerate them all; this read never hides a live action behind a     later-scheduled decoy.

transferOwnership(address).details: Ownership is part of the versioned governance state machine. The      inherited unversioned escape hatches are permanently disabled.

GOVERNANCE_ACTION_SCHEDULED_TOPIC.details: The scheduling event carries 17 pinned fields, beyond what legacy     codegen can stack for a Solidity `emit`, so `_emitActionScheduled`     emits it via `log4` with hand-laid ABI data; golden tests assert     topic and data byte layout against this constant.

ActionIdMismatch(bytes32).notice: Reverts when the recomputed action ID differs from the stored action.

BatchScopeHashMismatch(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Reverts when caller-supplied aggregate transition hashes are not derived from calls.

BatchValueMismatch(uint256,uint256).notice: Reverts when `msg.value` does not equal the batch value sum.

BatchValueSurplus(uint256).notice: Reverts when execution leaves surplus value in the executor.

CallDataCountMismatch(uint256,uint256).notice: Reverts when `callDatas` does not pair one-to-one with `calls`.

CallDataHashMismatch(uint256).notice: Reverts when a supplied calldata blob does not hash to `callDataHash`.

CallDataNotPublished(bytes32).notice: Reverts when scheduling a batch whose exact calldata preimages         have not been published onchain ([GOV-BATCH] rule 5).

CallDataTooShort(uint256).notice: Reverts when calldata is 1-3 bytes and cannot carry a selector.

CallSelectorMismatch(uint256).notice: Reverts when calldata's leading selector differs from the pinned selector.

CallsHashMismatch(bytes32).notice: Reverts when the recomputed calls hash differs from the stored action.

DelayBelowClassMinimum(uint8,uint64,uint.notice: Reverts when `notBefore` is earlier than the class minimum delay.

EmptyGovernanceBatch().notice: Reverts on scheduling an empty batch.

ExecutorConfigActionClassMismatch(addres.notice: Reverts when a direction-sensitive Executor self-configuration         call is scheduled under the wrong action class.

ExecutorControlActionClassMismatch(addre.notice: Reverts when a fixed-class Executor control-plane call is         scheduled under a different action class.

GovernanceActionExpiredWindow(bytes32,ui.notice: Reverts on executing or materializing against the expiry boundary.

GovernanceActionNotScheduled(bytes32).notice: Reverts when the action is not in the required lifecycle status.

GovernanceActionUnknown(bytes32).notice: Reverts when acting on an action ID with no stored record.

GovernanceActorNotAuthorized(address).notice: Reverts when the caller may not schedule or cancel actions.

GovernanceCallFailed(bytes32,uint256).notice: Reverts when a batch call fails without revert data.

GovernanceCallReturndataTooLarge(bytes32.notice: Reverts without copying a governed target's unbounded failure         payload when it exceeds the Executor's pinned bubbling cap.

GovernanceProposerAuthorizationDrift(byt.notice: Reverts when a registered proposer's queued action survives a         disable/re-enable or any other proposer-revision change.

GovernanceRootProposerRequired(address,a.notice: Reverts when a non-root proposer attempts to mutate the         Executor or its permanently owned RoleRegistry.

GovernanceRootRevisionMismatch(bytes32,u.notice: Reverts when a control-plane action was scheduled under an         earlier governance-root revision, including an address ABA.

GovernanceTimestampOverflow(uint256).notice: Reverts before narrowing or adding to a timestamp that cannot         fit the Governance V2 uint64 time domain.

InvalidActionWindow(uint64,uint64).notice: Reverts when `expiresAfter` is not after `notBefore` or exceeds         the launch-pinned maximum action lifetime.

InvalidExecutorConfigCall(address,bytes4.notice: Reverts when an Executor self-configuration call is not the         exact canonical ABI shape required for schedule-time direction proof.

InvalidManifestTailTrigger(address,bytes.notice: Reverts on invalid immutable tail rules or composition.

InvalidModuleRegistryStatusCall(address).notice: Reverts when a registered ModuleRegistry status call cannot be         decoded into its exact module and requested lifecycle state.

InvalidRoleManagerConfigCall(address).notice: Reverts when the bound RoleRegistry's RoleManager mutation is         not the exact canonical `registerRoleManager(address,bool)` ABI.

LiveTerminalFreezeIndexOutOfBounds(bytes.notice: Reverts on a live-terminal-freeze enumeration index out of bounds.

ModuleRegistryStatusActionClassMismatch(.notice: Reverts when the calldata-aware ModuleRegistry direction and         the scheduled action class disagree.

NativeReceiverNotApproved(address).notice: Reverts when an empty-calldata value transfer targets an         unapproved native receiver.

NoTerminalFreezeVetoGuardianConfigured(b.notice: Reverts when scheduling a TERMINAL_FREEZE action while no         ROLE_TERMINAL_FREEZE_VETO holder exists to exercise the veto.

NonCanonicalCallDataPublication().notice: Reverts when a published payload is not a canonical `abi.encode(bytes[])` value.

NotClassifiedTightening(address,bytes4).notice: Reverts when an IMMEDIATE_TIGHTENING call is not registered as         tightening by the classifier.

NotTerminalFreezeAction(bytes32).notice: Reverts when vetoing a non-terminal-freeze action.

NotTerminalFreezeVetoGuardian(address).notice: Reverts when the veto caller does not hold the per-scope or         global ROLE_TERMINAL_FREEZE_VETO authority.

OpenWindowBelowFloor(uint64,uint64).notice: Reverts when a delayed class has less than seven days in its         open-to-execute window.

RoleManagerConfigActionClassMismatch(add.notice: Reverts when RoleManager enablement/removal is scheduled under         the wrong direction-sensitive action class.

RoleRegistryDelayedActionRequired(uint8).notice: Reverts when an Executor-mediated RoleRegistry call attempts         to use a fast, terminal, or otherwise non-ordinary action class.

ScheduledCallDataMismatch(uint256).notice: Reverts when scheduled calldata bytes differ from the immutable publication.

SystemManifestBootstrapNotBound().notice: Reverts when an action is attempted before the one-way bootstrap is bound/sealed.

TargetHasNoCode(uint256,address).notice: Reverts when a non-native-transfer call targets an address without code.

TerminalFreezeClassRequired(address,byte.notice: Reverts when a batch containing a registered freeze         `(target, selector)` is scheduled under any class other than         TERMINAL_FREEZE (executor-side veto-floor backstop).

TerminalFreezeLiveActionCapExceeded(byte.notice: Reverts when one scope already has the maximum number of         simultaneously open terminal-freeze veto memberships.

TerminalFreezeNonRootLiveActionCapExceed.notice: Reverts when non-root proposers have consumed the shared         per-scope capacity reserved below the total live-action cap.

TerminalFreezePageCursorOutOfBounds(byte.notice: Reverts when a raw terminal-freeze page cursor exceeds the         current bounded membership length.

TerminalFreezePageLimitExceeded(uint256,.notice: Reverts when a raw terminal-freeze page requests more than the         protocol-pinned bounded page size.

TerminalFreezeProposerLiveActionCapExcee.notice: Reverts when one non-root proposer reaches its per-scope live         terminal-freeze membership cap.

TighteningCallSelfTargetForbidden(bytes4.notice: Reverts when the Executor's own hard-coded direction classifier         is targeted by the mutable tightening-call registry.

UnknownActionClass(uint8).notice: Reverts on scheduling with an action class outside the pinned set.

VetoDeadlinePassed(bytes32,uint64).notice: Reverts when vetoing after the veto deadline.

FreezeSelectorUpdated(uint16,address,byt.notice: Emitted when a known-irreversible freeze `(target, selector)` is         registered or cleared for the executor-side veto-floor backstop.

GovernanceActionExpired(uint16,bytes32,u.notice: Emitted when a virtual expiry is materialized into storage.

GovernanceCallDataPublished(uint16,bytes.notice: Emitted when a calldata preimage set is published onchain.

TerminalFreezeActionMembershipUpdated(ui.notice: Emitted after every raw terminal-freeze membership append or removal.

cancelGovernanceAction(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Cancels a scheduled action before execution.

commitGenesisPlan(bytes32).notice: Commit the exact initialization once, after all target code exists.

currentAction().notice: Returns the in-flight action context during batch execution so         governed targets can verify the executing action class.

executeGovernanceAction(bytes32,bytes).notice: Single-call execution wrapper over the stored first-call fields.

executeGovernanceBatch(bytes32,(address,.notice: Executes a scheduled batch; atomic, payable-value pinned         (`msg.value == sum(calls[].value)`), permissionless after         `notBefore` ([GOV-BATCH] rules 1-2).

extendGovernanceActionPolicy(uint64,byte.notice: Append 1–64 entries, with a total catalog limit of 1,024.

governanceAction(bytes32).notice: Returns the stored action; while `SCHEDULED` and past         `expiresAfter`, the returned status is virtually `EXPIRED`.

governanceNonce().notice: Returns the next nonce consumed by scheduling.

initializeGenesis((address,address,bytes.notice: Initialize and seal the real stack in one transaction.

isStreamGovernedParameterAuthority().notice: Returns true for deployment-time wiring validation.

liveTerminalFreezeActionAt(bytes32,uint2.notice: Returns the `index`-th live terminal-freeze action for         `scopeHash` and its veto deadline (`notBefore`).

liveTerminalFreezeActionCount(bytes32).notice: Returns the number of live (scheduled, pre-`notBefore`)         terminal-freeze actions affecting target scope `scopeHash`.

materializeExpiredAction(bytes32).notice: Materializes `EXPIRED` for a scheduled action past `expiresAfter`.

minimumDelay(uint8).notice: Returns the launch-pinned minimum delay for `actionClass`.

prepareGenesis((address,address,bytes32,.notice: Optionally bind the exact committed governance catalog/lifecycle         in a separate transaction before atomic product setup and sealing.

pruneElapsedTerminalFreezeActions(bytes3.notice: Permissionlessly removes memberships whose veto deadline has         elapsed. This does not mutate action status or pending counts.

publishGovernanceCallData(bytes[]).notice: Publishes the exact ordered calldata preimages for a batch as an         SSTORE2 blob ([GOV-BATCH] rule 5; ADR 0013 decision U5).

publishedCallData(bytes32).notice: Returns the published SSTORE2 pointer for a calldata key, or         the zero address when unpublished.

registerCanceller(address,bool).notice: Registers or removes a canceller (for example a guardian module).

registerFreezeSelector(address,bytes4,bo.notice: Registers or clears a known-irreversible freeze         `(target, selector)` for the executor-side veto-floor backstop         (FIX A). While registered, any batch containing a call to that         `(target, selector)` must be scheduled as `TERMINAL_FREEZE`,         forcing the [GOV-WINDOWS] rule 2 72h veto floor regardless of         the proposer-declared class.

registerProposer(address,bool).notice: Registers or removes a scheduling proposer through an isolated         versioned governance self-call.

roleRegistry().notice: Role registry resolving [GOV-ROLES], including the terminal veto role.

scheduleGovernanceAction((uint8,address,.notice: Single-call wrapper producing a byte-identical action ID to the         equivalent one-call batch.

scheduleGovernanceBatch(uint8,(address,u.notice: Schedules a batch of calls as one atomic governance action         ([GOV-ACTION-ID] explicit batch ABI; ADR 0011 decision R10).

scheduledCallData(bytes32).notice: Reads back the exact scheduled calldata preimages for `actionId`.

scheduledCallDataPointer(bytes32).notice: Returns the SSTORE2 pointer holding the scheduled calldata         preimages for `actionId` ([LTA-PAYLOAD-DISCOVERY] typed pointer).

setApprovedNativeReceiver(address,bool).notice: Approves a receiver for empty-calldata native ETH transfer calls         (ADR 0004 execution rule 4).

setTighteningCall(address,bytes4,bool).notice: Tightening classifier: registers `(target, selector)` pairs         proven unable to loosen policy, eligible for zero-delay         IMMEDIATE_TIGHTENING scheduling (ADR 0004 execution rule 2).

terminalFreezeActionPage(bytes32,uint256.notice: Returns one bounded page of raw veto-discovery memberships.

terminalFreezeLiveActionCaps().notice: Returns the total, shared non-root, and per-non-root-proposer         caps for open terminal-freeze memberships in one scope.

terminalFreezeLiveActionUsage(bytes32,ad.notice: Returns raw capacity usage for one scope and non-root proposer.

terminalFreezeVetoGuardian(bytes32).notice: Returns a target-transition scope's sole effective veto guardian         and the deadline of its EARLIEST live terminal-freeze action.

terminalFreezeVetoGuardianSet(bytes32).notice: Returns the exact RoleRegistry enumeration recipe for every         additive veto guardian effective for a scope.

vetoTerminalFreeze(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Vetoes a scheduled terminal-freeze action before its veto         deadline. A global holder or a holder for any distinct affected         per-call scope may veto the whole atomic batch.

userdoc.notice: Staged governance executor for 6529Stream implementing ADR 0004         [GOV-ACTION-ID] canonical action identity, [GOV-BATCH] atomic         payable batches, [GOV-WINDOWS] delay/window floors and the         terminal-freeze veto surface, with scheduled calldata preimages         published onchain via SSTORE2 (ADR 0013 decision U5).
